stops.title: Asɔre Baa Biara
stops.caption: Nhyehyɛeɛ no nyinaa.
stops.speech: Asɔre Mmaa kyerɛ beaeɛ biara a asɔre no wɔ, ne kurow, ne ɔmantam ne dodoɔ a wɔwɔ n’asafo mu.

stops.title: Emu
stops.caption: Nhyehyɛeɛ, akannifoɔ ne mufoɔ.
stops.speech: Bue asɔre baa bi na siesie ne nsɛm, fa ne sɔfoɔ ne sohwɛfoɔ ma, na hunu asɔrefoɔ, akuo ne ɔsom a ɛwɔ ne ase.
